pr.title: provision recipient-scoped Couchdrop link for staged reports

decisions.title: Provision a real recipient-scoped shared link, replacing the sentinel
decisions.chose: Provision a per-recipient Couchdrop shared link for each rendered practice PDF and put it on the envelope, replacing the live COUCHDROP_LINK_STUB_NEV_1539 sentinel.
decisions.rejected: Keep the sentinel / defer real link provisioning
decisions.why: The M2 batch pipeline needs a real shareable link on the envelope; the sentinel was a placeholder. This is the framing change the rest of the PR serves.

decisions.title: Isolate Couchdrop behind a client package with an in-process fake
decisions.chose: Add packages/couchdrop-client as a fetch-based client factory plus an in-process fake bound in tests.
decisions.rejected: Inline the HTTP calls in the batch-runner
decisions.why: A dedicated package keeps the HTTP wire contract in one place and lets CI bind a fake so no live Couchdrop call fires in tests.

provenanceTrail.reason: review (refactor) found CouchdropUploadError imported only to be re-exported, but ./test-utils never forwards it — removed the dead import/re-export, behavior-preserving

decisions.title: Gate each artifact behind isReportTypeEnabled before upload, fail-closed
decisions.chose: Check isReportTypeEnabled per artifact before uploading; the gate is === true and catches throws.
decisions.rejected: Upload unconditionally / fail-open on a broken flag source
decisions.why: PHI must not egress when the report type is disabled or the flag source is broken; a fail-closed gate withholds rather than uploads.

provenanceTrail.reason: diff-security: token stays only in the Authorization header (never logged/echoed), recipient email + shared link never logged, fail-closed gate (=== true, catches throws) cannot let a broken flag permit a PHI upload, header-value injection blocked by undici Headers validation

decisions.title: Add FAILED_COUCHDROP_UPLOAD / SKIPPED_ARTIFACT_FLAG_OFF outcomes and couchdrop.upload.* metrics
decisions.chose: Introduce two outcomes and couchdrop.upload.* counters/durations so an outage or a flag-off is observable and the batch continues.
decisions.rejected: Let an upload failure abort the batch / leave the skip unobservable
decisions.why: A Couchdrop outage should mark the artifact FAILED_COUCHDROP_UPLOAD and let the batch continue; a flag-off should record SKIPPED_ARTIFACT_FLAG_OFF — both need distinct outcomes and metrics.

decisions.title: Require COUCHDROP_API_* at config parse rather than optional-with-refine
decisions.chose: Declare COUCHDROP_API_* as .min(1) required in the Zod config.
decisions.why: PHI egress warrants failing at config parse rather than at first upload, matching the KAFKA_* fail-fast precedent. Local dev uses committed placeholders (batch gated off locally).

decisions.title: Register no teardown for the Couchdrop client (deliberate non-change)
decisions.chose: Leave the Couchdrop client out of main.ts teardown.
decisions.rejected: Register a SIGTERM teardown like the S3 client
decisions.why: It issues one-shot requests over the global fetch agent and holds no per-client socket pool to release, unlike the S3 client's AWS SDK connection. Documented in-code.

decisions.title: Follow the published Couchdrop API docs; leave two fields unverified until the live-tenant handoff
decisions.chose: Implement the two-host flow from the published docs (upload then create shared link); mark the recipient-email scoping field and the shared-URL response field TODO(NEV-1643), falling back to a constructed URL.
decisions.rejected: Block on a fully-verified wire contract before shipping
decisions.why: The docs expose password/expiry but not email-scoping; that field and the shared-URL response were proven manually. CI binds the fake (no live call); both get confirmed against the live tenant at the NEV-1643 handoff. This is a trust boundary the reviewer is asked to accept.

decisions.title: Defer the artifact-ordering collapse fix to NEV-1373/1374
decisions.chose: Document the ordering assumption in-code and defer the fix
decisions.rejected: Fix the SKIPPED_FLOOR collapse (which orphans a completed upload) now
decisions.why: Not reachable today — generatePracticeReport always returns GENERATED; real floor logic and independent per-report-type eligibility land with NEV-1373/1374. Bounded even when reachable: publish is gated after the loop so no HubSpot send fires, and re-upload is idempotent on remotePath.

provenanceTrail.reason: review (diff-critic) flagged the ordering wrinkle; deferred to the ticket that makes it reachable and documented in-code

decisions.title: Keep per-file metric-emit helpers rather than extracting a shared one
decisions.rejected: Extract a shared metric-emit helper across the three call sites
decisions.why: Per-file emit helpers are the established local convention; a shared helper would edit two pre-existing unchanged files (publish-practice-report.ts, write-ledger-row.ts).

provenanceTrail.reason: review (refactor) flagged the third near-copy; won't-fix, awareness only
